basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old graphic designer living in Seattle, WA. I've been battling with acne since my teenage years, which led me to join the acne subreddit to share experiences and tips. I work remotely, so my hours can be a bit erratic, but I usually browse Reddit in the evenings. I'm single and enjoy hiking around Lake Arrowhead during weekends. I'm passionate about fantasy novels like 'Beginning After The End' and I'm trying to learn more about anatomy to improve my drawing skills. I dislike overly strict rules and enjoy the freedom of creative expression.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in graphic design, a skill I've honed through a combination of a degree in Fine Arts and years of freelance work. My interest in skincare is mostly driven by personal experience, supplemented by countless hours of reading and participating in skincare forums.
